skill.name: playwright-skill
skill.description: Browser automation skill for Playwright tasks. It detects local dev servers, generates temporary test scripts, runs page interactions, captures screenshots, and reports results.
skill.summary: Create and run Playwright browser checks for local or provided URLs.
skill.author: lackeyjb

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples and JavaScript template literals. Real risks remain in the local JavaScript executor, automatic installation commands, disabled Chromium sandbox flags, localhost port probing, and environment-derived request headers.

remediation.issue: Generated JavaScript is executed with local Node permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit confirmation step, show the generated script, and run it in a constrained sandbox when possible.

remediation.issue: Runtime setup runs npm and npx commands automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Move installation to an explicit setup step, pin dependencies, and require user approval before running package commands.

remediation.issue: Chromium launches with sandbox protections disabled by default.
remediation.suggestion: Remove --no-sandbox defaults and make sandbox disabling an explicit opt-in for compatible container environments.

remediation.issue: Localhost development server detection probes common ports.
remediation.suggestion: Ask before scanning, limit probes to requested ports, and clearly report which ports are checked.

remediation.issue: Environment-derived headers may carry secrets to browser targets.
remediation.suggestion: Require target-origin confirmation before applying custom headers and warn against production credentials.

semantic_findings.title: Environment Headers Can Be Forwarded to Visited Sites
semantic_findings.description: The helper reads PW_HEADER_VALUE and PW_EXTRA_HEADERS from environment variables and merges them into browser extraHTTPHeaders. Secrets placed there can be sent to every target origin used with the helper.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The source environment variables are parsed and later assigned to extraHTTPHeaders. The risk depends on user configuration and target origin, so medium severity is appropriate.

medium_findings.title: Environment Headers Can Be Forwarded to Visited Sites

medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The source environment variables are parsed and later assigned to extraHTTPHeaders. The risk depends on user configuration and target origin, so medium severity is appropriate.

content.value_statement: Manual browser checks are slow and easy to miss. This skill creates Playwright automation for page tests, forms, screenshots, responsive checks, and link checks.
actual_capabilities: Detects running localhost development servers on common ports.
Runs Playwright scripts through a local Node executor.
Creates screenshots for desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.
Automates clicks, typing, login flows, and form submission checks.
Checks links, page titles, console output, and selected UI states.
Adds optional custom HTTP headers from configured environment variables.
limitations: It requires Playwright and browser dependencies on the local machine.
It executes generated JavaScript, so untrusted tasks need careful review.
External websites may block automation or require manual authentication.
Visual quality judgments still need human review of screenshots.

use_cases.title: Validate a Local Web App
use_cases.description: Detect the active dev server, open key pages, and report obvious UI or navigation failures.

use_cases.title: Check Release Flows
use_cases.description: Exercise login, forms, redirects, and broken links before a deployment or demo.

use_cases.title: Capture Responsive Evidence
use_cases.description: Create screenshots across common device sizes for review, bug reports, or design acceptance.

prompt_templates.title: Test One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Detect my local dev server, open the main page, take desktop and mobile screenshots, and report visible layout issues.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Login Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Test the login flow on my local app. Ask for credentials if needed, then verify redirect behavior and visible success indicators.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Links and Forms
prompt_templates.prompt: Check important links and one contact form on the provided URL. Report broken links, failed submissions, and console errors.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Browser Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Playwright review for TARGET_URL covering responsive screenshots, login, broken links, console errors, and page readiness. Ask before running commands.

output_examples.input: Test my marketing page on the running dev server.
output: Detected one local server and opened the marketing page.
Captured desktop and mobile screenshots in the temporary directory.
Reported a mobile navigation overlap and one missing call-to-action state.
Opened the login page and submitted the provided test account.
Confirmed the dashboard redirect after successful login.
Noted one slow network request that delayed the ready state.

output_examples.input: Find broken outbound links on this page.
output: Collected visible outbound links from the page.
Checked each link response and summarized failures.
Returned the broken link list with status codes and page context.

best_practices: Review generated scripts before running them against sensitive systems.
Use test accounts and temporary data for login and form checks.
Limit custom headers to trusted target origins.
anti_patterns: Do not run arbitrary browser scripts from untrusted prompts without review.
Do not send production credentials through environment headers by default.
Do not treat screenshots as a complete accessibility or security audit.

faq.question: Does this skill install Playwright?
faq.answer: The executor can run setup commands when Playwright is missing. Review installation commands before use in restricted environments.

faq.question: Can it test local development servers?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks common localhost ports and can use the detected server for browser automation.

faq.question: Can it test external websites?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a URL and confirm that automated testing is allowed for that site.

faq.question: Does it run in a visible browser?
faq.answer: The skill prefers visible browser runs unless headless mode is requested.

faq.question: Where are temporary scripts and screenshots stored?
faq.answer: The instructions use temporary paths, usually under the system temporary directory.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: It executes generated JavaScript locally, so users should review scripts and avoid sensitive credentials.
